extracted_information: Intercom offers AI-powered customer service with two main pricing models: either as part of their platform (seat-based with additional Fin AI Agent resolution costs) or as a standalone Fin AI Agent integrated with existing helpdesks. All plans include the Fin AI Agent, charged per resolution. There are specific free components for certain features and AI capabilities.

fin_standalone_pricing.description: Use Fin AI Agent with your current helpdesk (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce)
fin_standalone_pricing.additional_fees: None (no integration fees, setup fees, or platform charges)

free_components: Free, unlimited live-chat included with all plans
Free support email included with all plans
Free in-app chats included with all plans
Free banners included with all plans
Free tooltips included with all plans
Free use of personal AI assistant (Copilot) for 10 conversations per agent/month
Free use of AI Auto-translation for 10 conversations per agent/month
20 free Lite seats included with Advanced plan
50 free Lite seats included with Expert plan
Free trial availability for all features

fin_ai_agent.description: The primary AI Agent for customer service.
capabilities: Can be integrated with current helpdesks (Zendesk, Salesforce)
Answers email, live chat, phone, and more (when standalone)
Takes action on external systems (when standalone)
Hands off to agents in preferred Inbox (when standalone)

personal_ai_assistant_for_agents.description: AI assistant within the inbox to increase agent efficiency.
personal_ai_assistant_for_agents.cost: Free for 10 Copilot and 10 AI Auto-translation conversations per agent/month

other_platform_features: Advanced in-app and outbound support features (Posts, Checklists, Product Tours, Surveys, Series campaign builder)

temporal_info.billing_frequency: Annually for seat costs on platform plans
